class.name: TweensGdCancellation
class.description: Pass a token to [method TweensGdHandle.wait] or [method TweensGdGroup.wait]. Cancelling returns [code]Tweens.Reason.WAIT_CANCELLED[/code] to those waits and leaves playback running. Use the handle or group's [code]cancel()[/code] to stop playback. Tokens cannot be reset. C# equivalent: [code]CancellationTokenSource[/code] and its token.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Cancels connected waits once. Playback keeps running. Use Godot's main thread.

members.member: True after [method cancel] has been called. Tokens cannot be reset.

signal.name: cancelled
signal.description: Emitted once when this token cancels connected waits.
